annotations.text: Armory · home. Every saber is its own identity (wiring, presets, backups, firmware). Connected saber gets a banner; the on-ramp for CFX / Xenopixel owners sits here, not buried in settings.

Presets · Tier 1. Everything here writes presets.ini over serial with no build. One look row per blade, curated by role: crystals and accents default to 'Follow main blade', motors to 'Spin while ignited'. Linked colours show the link and can be unlinked. Snapshot before every change → Undo always works.
Looks · gallery of compiled styles. 'Compiled in' looks are free to reuse; 'Needs build' looks show their flash cost and the resulting budget before the user commits. Fett263 GPL attribution is kept.

Build & Install · Tier 2. Amber = writes firmware. Flash meter first, pre-flight second, then a six-step timeline with honest timing (about 1 min build + 1 min DFU write). Errors are translated to the preset that caused them; compiler output is one click away.

Fonts & SD · Tier 3. Validation catches the two classic font failures (mono/poly mix, 48 kHz files) before they reach the saber. Naming converter maps CFX / Xenopixel names to Proffie names on the copy only.

Hardware wizard · count first, then one card per blade: role (main, crystal, accent, side, motor) + type (pixel, star LED, single LED, motor) + wiring as a choice between 'own data line' and 'continues Blade N's wire' (sub-blade ranges are computed). Cards collapse when complete; the diagram and pin table beside them are the live budget. BladeConfig is identity.

Tokens, type, components and the accessibility contract. Contrast ratios are computed against the panel colour #101720. Section 07 lists the six in-universe moves that carry the feel without any franchise assets.
